title: Thanksgiving Movies is live in Quick Rank
caption:
🦃 New in Quick Rank: Thanksgiving Movies.

Planes, Trains and Automobiles or Home for the Holidays? Addams Family Values or Free Birds? Tap the better one, 10 picks, and you've got your Thanksgiving top 10.

Which one do you watch every single year?

title: How to make a holiday gift list with a budget in 3 steps
caption:
🎁 Holiday gift list in 3 steps:

1. Tap + on the Lists tab and filter by Gifts.
2. Found something in Amazon or another store app? Tap Share and send it to your list.
3. Set a budget, note who gets what, and check off gifts as you buy them.

Who's the hardest person on your list to shop for?

#Listworthy #GiftIdeas

title: How to share a ranked list with friends: Send a Copy in Listworthy
caption:
📲 New in Listworthy: Send a Copy.

Open any list, tap Share, then Send a Copy. Your friend taps the link and gets the whole list in their Listworthy, posters, scores, tiers and notes included.

Now you can finally prove your top 10 is better than theirs.

Who's getting your list first?

#Listworthy

title: How to save Thanksgiving recipes from Pinterest as clean recipe cards
caption:
🥧 Thanksgiving recipes, minus the life story, in 3 steps:

1. Find a recipe page or Pinterest pin and tap Share.
2. Send it to Listworthy and get just the ingredients and steps.
3. Cooking? Cook mode keeps your screen on. After dinner, tap "I made this" and give it a score.

What's the one dish your table can't skip?

#Listworthy #ThanksgivingRecipes

title: Higher or Lower: a free movie, TV and video game guessing game for iPhone
caption:
🎬 New game in Listworthy: Higher or Lower.

Does the next movie score higher or lower than the last one? One wrong guess ends the run.

It works for movies, TV, games and books. Albums and comics play by release year instead.

Start on the Rank tab: tap a category, then Higher or Lower.

What's your best streak? Post it below.

#Listworthy
